widthMethod: real FrameDivider drag (the vertical one — the divider taller than it is wide), measured back off the panel box before every shot; the filename carries the MEASURED width, not the requested one
themeMethod: ThemeManager.setMode, read back off documentElement[data-theme] in a separate eval after a wait, before every shot
designMode: ON — the topbar's own Design button. EditorDocument gates the preview outline behind !previewMode (DES-001), so state 3 cannot be photographed in preview mode.
drive: scripts/devtools/drive-tvw004-ac1.js, 14/14 graded arms at each width
whatToLookAt: 3-selected--light--238px.png: a deliberate selection also feeds the box-model chip, which covers a good part of the hero. TVW-002 kept the chip off the PLACEMENT channel for this reason; a real selection is supposed to have it. Is that right here?
2-editing--*--238px.png: band labels truncate at MIN_PANEL_WIDTH (INSIDE LIM...). The tree says Limiter two rows above, so nothing is lost — the question is whether it looks unfinished.

notEvidencedHere: Peers were working on P78 (templates), P94 (styles panel) and P96 (backend feed) in the same checkout during this session. None of those surfaces appears in these images and none is evidenced by them.
